objective: Standard statement: decide every signed three-bit law (the 34 knots with weights plus or minus one on their tuples, global sign fixed: 1,168 rules) on SG_k for k = 1 to 10 by exact computation; group the exact ones under the symmetries that preserve exactness (complement, the b-c reflection of the gasket, relabelings by position parity) and under the theorems of ticket A; prove the infinite families found (expected: the relabelings of signed not-all-equal, parity at powers of 2) and state the rest as observations or conjectures. Nearest known result: SIGNED-SUBDIVISION-20261029-001A (signed census under shared subdivision); INTERFERENCE-20261029-001B (native gadgets); Newman-Moore self-similarity. Classification: to be decided.
status: Proved by SIGNED-GASKETS-20261029-001B-P001 (V1, exact census k = 2 to 12 plus proofs for the families): 68 of 1,168 signed laws are exact on some gasket; 26 lie in families explained for every k (signed not-all-equal and rotations at every k; their relabelings by position parity at odd k; (-1)^a [NAE] at k = 1, 2 mod 4 with its relabelings at k = 1 mod 4, factor nonzero to k = 22 and conjectured beyond; unsigned parity at powers of 2 by Lucas); 42 are sporadic (30 three-excluded at k = 3, 12 not-all-equal at k = 5).
title: Which signed laws reproduce themselves on which gaskets
